title: Making My Website Easier to Read
text:
CSS and SCSS
CSS controls the appearance of HTML elements. SCSS adds features such as variables and nesting, then compiles into CSS. In Quarto, a custom SCSS file can extend a Bootstrap theme.

My takeaway
Separating content from styling makes the website easier to update. I can change a color or font in one file and apply it across the site. I also need to check contrast, spacing, and navigation on smaller screens.

title: Browse My Learning Projects
text:
How this page works
listing:
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  fields: [title, description, categories]
  categories: true
  filter-ui: true
  sort: title
Each project provides a title, description, and categories in its YAML header. The listing reads those fields and creates the cards. Category controls help visitors browse by topic; the filter helps them find a specific entry.

title: Browse My Learning Projects
text:
How I would use listings
For my portfolio, I could organize marketing analytics, AI research, and creative projects in one place. This would help an employer explore work that matches the role they are hiring for.

title: TBFI | CEP Project Overview
text:
Tarkington Business Futures Institute (TBFI)
A project focused on AI-assisted research coding and validation.



AI-assisted meta-analysis
Compare CALIPER-assisted coding with human coding using secondary research materials.



Dashboard walkthrough and feedback
Help communicate the workflow clearly and identify where dashboard explanations need improvement.






Our project focuses on personalization in marketing communication. We use a published meta-analysis as a benchmark for evaluating research coding with CALIPER.
The comparison centers on extracting effect-size information, aligning outcome constructs, and documenting coding decisions. This dashboard describes the project design; it does not report completed validation results.






Objective
Focus




AO1
Effect-size extraction accuracy


AO2
Outcome construct alignment with CALIPER


AO3
Optional synthetic versus human validation extension


AO4
Dashboard walkthrough accuracy and feedback










Review the source article and coding instructions.
Record human coding decisions with page-level evidence.
Review CALIPER-assisted output.
Compare fields and document disagreements.
Summarize accuracy and agreement after validation.











Measure
Evidence required




Extraction accuracy
Verified reference coding and matched AI fields


Outcome alignment
Agreed outcome categories and coding rules


Coding agreement
Matched independent ratings


Walkthrough feedback
Documented review observations



Results are pending. No simulated performance numbers are presented.

title: SQL and Marketing Data
text: I am developing SQL skills to select, filter, and summarize marketing data. Understanding the data structure first helps me write queries that answer a clear business question. This entry is a learning summary; it does not present a completed analysis.

title: Hi, I’m Simran Kaur
text:
Marketing, analytics, and creative thinking
I am pursuing my M.S. in Digital Marketing & Analytics at Cal Poly Pomona. My background includes graphic design, e-commerce, and visual storytelling. I enjoy combining creative ideas with data to understand customers and communicate insights clearly.
